description:
Turn a short project idea into a first sketch: core modules and features,
a phased plan with durations, and the key questions to answer first. Use this
when someone describes software they want built. It is a rough first-pass
estimate, not a quote; present it that way.

idea.description: The project idea in the person's own words, e.g. 'online booking for my dental clinic'
idea.title: Idea
